# Storeez Design System

> Dark-native, MD3-derived, multi-brand design system (5 brands × 2 modes: storeez, kumite, ilot, travelz, violet — dark/light). AI-native: Honest AI contract, 8 universal states, Lucide-only iconography, machine-readable component registry.

## Read first
- readme.md: design guide, brand matrix, content + visual foundations, locked stack decisions
- AGENTS.md: hard generation rules (binding, CI-enforced)
- CLAUDE.md: agent-native summary of the rules
- registry.json: component registry — 34 components with variants, states, tokens, aiPrompt
- storeez-component.schema.json: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) every component.json validates against
- tokens.json: DTCG token source of truth (global → semantic → component tiers)
- styles.css: compiled CSS custom properties (the token closure)
- SKILL.md: the storeez-design agent skill
- component-lab.dc.html: the living spec — sections 01–20 covering tokens, components, AI patterns, agentic primitives, contracts, governance
- agentic-layer.html: the machine-readable metadata layer rendered — schema, AGENTS.md, registry, front-matter, trust levels

## Rules that trip models up
- --md-sys-color-primary is a FILL; text uses --md-sys-color-primary-text
- No emoji anywhere. No raw hex in component code. No gradients or glassmorphism.
- Never transition a colour property bound to an --md-sys-color-* token.
- Every AI output carries what/why/confidence/override/disclaimer.
